data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: body
sections.question: body
sections.summary: the whole physical structure of a person or animal

senses.definition: the whole physical structure of a person or animal, including bones, flesh, and organs
examples: Exercise is good for your body and your mind.
The human body needs water, food, and sleep to stay healthy.

answers.answer: She exercises every day to keep her body strong and healthy.
He drives his body to the office and parks it outside.
She bought a new body at the shopping centre last weekend.
They planted a body in the garden and watered it every morning.

sections.title: clinic
sections.question: clinic
sections.summary: a place where people go to receive medical treatment or advice

senses.definition: a building or part of a hospital where people go to receive medical treatment or advice
examples: She went to the clinic because she had a bad cough.
There is a dental clinic near the school.

answers.answer: She made an appointment at the clinic to see the nurse.
He bought fresh bread and vegetables at the clinic every week.
She went to the clinic to swim and use the gym.
They opened a clinic on the high street to sell clothes and shoes.

sections.title: cough
sections.question: cough
sections.summary: to push air out of your throat with a short loud sound, often because you are ill

senses.definition: to suddenly force air out of your throat with a short loud sound, especially when you are ill or something is irritating your throat
examples: He started to cough because of the dust in the old room.
She coughed loudly during the meeting.

senses.definition: an act of coughing, or an illness that causes you to cough a lot
examples: She has a bad cough and needs to rest.
He bought some medicine for his cough.

answers.answer: He coughed loudly because he had a cold and a sore throat.
She coughed her bag onto the table and sat down.
He coughed the window and looked outside at the rain.
They coughed dinner at seven o'clock every evening.

sections.title: doctor
sections.question: doctor
sections.summary: a person who has been trained to treat people who are sick or injured

senses.definition: a person who has studied medicine and is trained to treat people who are sick or injured
examples: She visited the doctor because she had a very high temperature.
The doctor told him to rest and drink plenty of water.

answers.answer: She made an appointment with the doctor about her sore throat.
He ordered a doctor from the menu at the restaurant.
She bought a new doctor at the supermarket on Saturday.
They parked their doctor outside the school and walked in.

sections.title: exercise
sections.question: exercise
sections.summary: physical activity that you do to stay healthy and strong

senses.definition: physical activity that you do in order to stay healthy and keep your body strong
examples: Regular exercise is very important for good health.
She does an hour of exercise at the gym every morning.

senses.definition: to do physical activities in order to stay healthy and keep your body strong
examples: She exercises for thirty minutes every day.
He exercises at the gym three times a week.

answers.answer: She does exercise every morning to stay fit and healthy.
He ate the exercise for breakfast before going to work.
She drove her exercise to the park and left it there.
They cooked exercise in a big pan and served it for lunch.

sections.title: fever
sections.question: fever
sections.summary: a higher than normal body temperature, usually because you are ill

senses.definition: a medical condition in which your body temperature is higher than normal, usually because you are ill
examples: She stayed in bed all day because she had a high fever.
The doctor said the fever would go down in a day or two.

answers.answer: He stayed home from school because he had a fever.
She cooked a fever for dinner and served it with bread.
He drove his fever to the supermarket to buy food.
They planted a fever in the garden and watered it each day.

sections.title: headache
sections.question: headache
sections.summary: a continuous pain that you feel inside your head

senses.definition: a continuous pain that you feel in your head
examples: She took some medicine for her headache.
He often gets a headache when he spends too long looking at a screen.

answers.answer: She took some medicine because she had a bad headache.
He ate a headache for lunch with a glass of water.
She drove her headache to work and parked outside.
They bought a headache at the supermarket for five euros.

sections.title: healthy
sections.question: healthy
sections.summary: in good physical condition; not sick

senses.definition: in good physical condition; not ill or injured
examples: She feels healthy because she eats well and exercises regularly.
A healthy diet includes plenty of vegetables and fruit.

answers.answer: She eats fresh fruit and vegetables every day to stay healthy.
He locked the healthy in a drawer and forgot about it.
She drove her healthy to the office every morning.
They planted a healthy in the garden and watered it daily.

sections.title: hospital
sections.question: hospital
sections.summary: a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment

senses.definition: a large building where people who are ill or injured go to receive medical treatment and care
examples: She was taken to hospital after the accident.
He spent three days in hospital after his operation.

answers.answer: She was taken to hospital after she broke her arm.
He goes to the hospital every Saturday to buy fresh bread.
She visits the hospital each week to play tennis and swim.
They opened a new hospital to sell furniture and home goods.

sections.title: medicine
sections.question: medicine
sections.summary: a substance you take to treat an illness or reduce pain

senses.definition: a substance that you take to treat an illness or reduce pain
examples: The doctor gave her some medicine for her cold.
He takes medicine every morning for his blood pressure.

answers.answer: The doctor gave him some medicine to help with his fever.
She cooked the medicine in a pan and served it for dinner.
He drove the medicine to work and used it as a desk.
They planted medicine in the garden and watered it every day.
